title: Padded clone scope
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with uniform refinement $R$, and let $r,M$ be natural numbers. Suppose every outcome of $E$ has predicate arity at most $r$. For a padded clone occurrence, the scope sends each position of its sampled outcome's predicate to the pair consisting of that outcome's variable at the position and the clone index assigned to that position.
